Types of Functional Limitations
Functional limitations in the physical domain deal with
the performance of sensorimotor tasks, that is, total body
actions that are typically components or elements of func-
tional activities.2,89 These activities include basic activities
of daily living (ADL), such as bathing, dressing, or feed-
ing, and the more complex tasks known as instrumental
activities of daily living (IADL), such as occupational
tasks, school-related skills, housekeeping, and recreational
activities, or community mobility (driving, using public
transportation), just to name a few.
